item.title: Self-Hosted Serial Server: ser2net vs conserver vs socat Guide
item.description: Managing serial devices across a distributed infrastructure is a challenge that many homelab operators and enterprise IT teams face daily. Whether you are connecting to console ports on network switches, reading data from industrial sensors, or managing legacy hardware, a serial server bridges the gap between physical serial ports and network-accessible interfaces. In this guide, we compare three powerful open-source solutions — ser2net, conserver, and socat — for self-hosting serial device access over your network.
